source_plan_title: Project Prime: Full RmlUi Migration Implementation Plan

status_definitions.not-started: No production RmlUi implementation established in the pinned baseline. Existing legacy workflow remains required.
status_definitions.partial: A real proof implementation covers some behavior; required authority/lifetime/platform/failure cases are not accepted.
status_definitions.functional: Complete behavior has been exercised for named environment(s), with attached evidence; no universal parity implied.
status_definitions.parity-verified: Legacy equivalent behavior and required production platform/input/lifetime matrix have been accepted with immutable evidence.

status_policy: This is a source inventory, not a test result. No row is parity-verified. Preserve this baseline; attach later head-specific evidence and current statuses in a separate assessment. Source-generated control catalog intentionally includes helpers and legacy/studio adapters. Dynamic rows need semantic expansion during parity audit.

slices.title: Baseline, ownership map and reliable CI (required, first)
slices.acceptance: Green native bridge compile on both macOS architectures plus Linux, content-free regression, basic direct input test, stable release baseline and explicitly recorded known failures.

slices.title: Promote the proof to an engine-owned RmlUi runtime (required, foundation)
slices.acceptance: Home/Play/Lobby/Rules retain current behavior using the new runtime. Documents can open/close 100 times without stale callbacks, leaked GPU resources, broken focus or extra network pumps. UI snapshots do not depend on Avalonia types.

slices.title: Shared navigation, components and visual system (required)
slices.acceptance: Every existing RmlUi page uses the new shell and common components; navigation, modal priority and focus history pass keyboard/gamepad tests.

slices.title: Complete input, focus, text and accessibility contracts (required; begin with RML-01)
slices.acceptance: Real physical input checks succeed across pointer DPI values (1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0), gamepad, mouse, keyboard, touch and Unicode editing; no duplicate clicks and no dead focus states.

slices.title: Extract the actual lobby controller from Avalonia (required, **critical path**)
slices.acceptance: Create/join/ready/change Hunter/start/load/play/end/return/leave cycles work in an RmlUi-only *render mode*, with no hidden `LobbyScreen`, on a real dedicated server and local server. Simulated packet loss, multiple spectators, join-in-progress, Unicode roster entries and server restarts do not wedge the app.

slices.title: Finish lobby owner/admin and matchmaking features (required; depends on RML-04)
slices.acceptance: Two-client, four-client and eight-client dedicated-server tests cover every admin action and owner permission. Match begins and returns correctly; server authority rejects spoofed guest commands.

slices.title: Complete Hunter selection, cosmetics, loadouts and teams (required)
slices.acceptance: All Hunters/suits/loadouts can be selected with mouse/controller/touch; remote peers see the authoritative choice; high-refresh preview animation remains smooth; independent cosmetic previews do not leak resources.

slices.title: Merge social, friends, parties and invites (required)
slices.acceptance: Real multi-account clients can invite/accept/decline, travel as a party, join reserved slots, reconnect and leave without leaking auth tokens or corrupting lobby ownership.

slices.title: Production Settings, setup and update UI (required)
slices.acceptance: Every setting round-trips to existing persisted values and old-client preferences; never loses saved settings when navigating away or on failed apply; works on all target platforms.

slices.title: Hunter License, profile, identity and account (required)
slices.acceptance: Local/offline/online profile parity with the old UI, successful account flows and bounded retries; no security regressions.

slices.title: Community browsing, sharing and publishing (required)
slices.acceptance: Publish/revise/remove/download/install/join a community map using RmlUi and verify all the same authorization/validation semantics as legacy UI.

slices.title: Offline battle, practice and Adventure entry (required)
slices.acceptance: Full offline match → pause → end → rematch/home and Adventure save → play → return cycles pass on every desktop backend and on Android.

slices.title: Replay library, Theatre and launch-to-Studio surface (required)
slices.acceptance: Replay search/playback/seek/spectate/exit works without Avalonia client screens; fullscreen mouse/keyboard/gamepad focus survives tabbing and device changes.

slices.title: All Avalonia-owned in-game menus and overlays (required)
slices.acceptance: 60/120/144/240 Hz and multiplayer smoke tests confirm functional parity and no fire/jump/aim input regression when menus open/close.

slices.title: Map/HUD/creation-tool client entry migration (required, architecture decision)
slices.acceptance: No user-facing edit/publish/save operation in the game requires an Avalonia screen. If editing was moved to Studio, there must be a working open-file deep link and explicit product acceptance for the separate application.

slices.title: Modern-GPU RmlUi rendering backend (required; **start in parallel with RML-02/04**)
slices.acceptance: Identical layout/input semantics and no validation errors on GL fallback, Windows DX12+Vulkan, Linux Vulkan, macOS Vulkan/MoltenVK or the designated Metal backend path, with lost-device/recovery tests. No game logic or UI behavior forks per backend.

slices.title: Desktop platform production bridge and packaging (required; after RML-15 integration begins)
slices.acceptance: Downloaded builds boot into RmlUi without manual native build steps on clean Windows, macOS and Linux machines and return from gameplay/replay without process restart.

slices.title: Android RmlUi platform bridge (required, separate runtime work)
slices.acceptance: On supported physical Android devices: create/join lobby, edit settings, chat, select Hunter, play, pause, spectate, return, background/resume, rotate if supported, disconnect/reconnect, and no native crash/leak/stuck keyboard.

slices.title: Full parity audit, regressions, accessibility and performance (required)
slices.acceptance: A signed-off parity matrix has **zero unexplained blocked workflows**, no critical regressions, passed native GPU validation on every shipping backend, and a reproducible performance/evidence report.

slices.title: Make RmlUi the default, canary rollout and rollback (required)
slices.acceptance: RmlUi is the shipping default for all supported game-client platforms and ordinary workflows; emergency rollback exists without using a development build.

slices.title: Remove Avalonia from the **game client** (required, last)
slices.acceptance: Clean Windows/macOS/Linux/Android **game-client** builds and CI succeed with **no Avalonia UI assemblies required by that client**, with all user workflows and dedicated-server checks passing.
